questions.question: The "National communal harmony campaign week" was observed between __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**19th to 25th November**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The "National Communal Harmony Campaign Week" is observed annually from **19th to 25th November** in India.
 
• It is organized by the **National Foundation for Communal Harmony (NFCH)**, an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The campaign aims to **promote communal harmony, national integration, and unity among diverse communities** in the country.
 
• During this week, various awareness programs, campaigns, and activities are conducted across schools, colleges, and communities to emphasize the importance of peace and harmony.
 
• The week also includes the observance of **Flag Day on 25th November**, which seeks contributions to support children affected by communal violence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Foundation for Communal Harmony (NFCH):**

 
 
• The NFCH was established in 1992 with the aim of fostering communal harmony and national integration.
 
• It provides assistance to children rendered orphan or destitute in communal violence, helping them with education and rehabilitation.
 
• The foundation also conducts various campaigns and initiatives to spread awareness about peace and unity.
 
 
 
• **Communal Harmony:**
 
 
• Communal harmony refers to peaceful coexistence and mutual respect among different religious, ethnic, and cultural groups in society.
 
• It is crucial for maintaining social stability and fostering economic growth in a diverse country like India.
 
• Efforts to promote communal harmony include education, dialogue, and cultural exchange programs.
 
 
 
• **Flag Day Contributions:**
 
 
• Flag Day is observed on 25th November during the National Communal Harmony Campaign Week.
 
• On this day, funds are collected to support children affected by communal violence.
 
• The funds are utilized for their education, healthcare, and overall well-being.
 
 
 
• **Importance of National Integration:**
 
 
• National integration refers to the sense of unity and solidarity among citizens irrespective of their differences.
 
• It is essential for maintaining peace, stability, and progress in a multicultural nation like India.
 
• Campaigns like the "National Communal Harmony Campaign Week" play a pivotal role in fostering national integration.

questions.question: National Maritime Day, which commemorates the historic voyage of India's first steamship 'S.S. Loyalty', is observed annually on which date?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**April 5.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW) celebrated the 62nd National Maritime Day on April 5, 2025, with central events held in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• National Maritime Day is observed annually on **April 5** to commemorate the first Indian merchant ship, **S.S. Loyalty**, which sailed from Mumbai to London in 1919.
 
• The 2025 celebration marked the **62nd edition** of National Maritime Day.
 
• The theme for 2025 was **“Prosperous Seas – Developed India and Youth for Blue Economy and Green Growth.”**
 
• Union Minister Shri Sarbananda Sonowal addressed the event in New Delhi and interacted with maritime cadets and professionals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• S.S. Loyalty__

 __
 
• First Indian-owned steamship to sail internationally.
 
• Operated by Scindia Steam Navigation Company Ltd.
 
• Sailed from Mumbai to London on April 5, 1919.
 
 
 
• National Maritime Day__
 __
 
• First celebrated in 1964 to honor India’s maritime legacy.
 
• Recognizes the contribution of seafarers and maritime stakeholders to national growth.
 
 
 
• 2025 Celebrations__
 
 
• Organized by the National Maritime Day Celebration Committee (NMDCC) and MoPSW.
 
• Events included cultural activities, awards, sports, and seminars across India’s maritime institutions.

questions.question: What is the theme of World Leprosy Day 2025?

options.text: Beat Leprosy, End Stigma and Advocate for Mental Well-Being

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Unite. Act. Eliminate.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Leprosy Day** is observed on the **last Sunday of January each year** to raise awareness about leprosy, also known as **Hansen's disease**.
 
• Leprosy is a contagious disease that causes disfiguring skin sores and nerve damage in the arms, legs, and other regions of the body.
 
• It is caused by **Mycobacterium leprae**, a slow-growing pathogen (M. leprae).
 
• It is also known as Hansen's disease, after the man who discovered M. leprae in 1873.
 
• Leprosy is diagnosed based on the number and type of skin lesions you have.
 
• The type of leprosy determines the symptoms and treatment options. Mycobacterium leprae is a bacterium that causes leprosy, often known as "Hansen's disease," a chronic infectious disease that affects the skin, eyes, nose, and muscles and damages peripheral nerves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Act Now. End Leprosy was the theme for World Leprosy Day 2023.**
 
• **United for Dignity** was the theme for** World Leprosy Day 2022.**
 
• **Beat Leprosy, End Stigma and Advocate for Mental Well-Being **was the theme for **World Leprosy Day 2021.**

questions.question: What is the theme of United Nations World Wildlife Day (WWD) 2025?

questions.question: What does India observe every year on May 30?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Hindi Journalism Day**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

• 
 
**Hindi Journalism Day** is observed every year on **May 30** in India.

 
 
• 
 
It honors the **beginning of journalism** in the **Hindi language**.

 
 
• 
 
The observance dates back to **1826**, with the publication of **Udant Martand**, the country’s first **Hindi newspaper**.

 
 
• 
 
**Pandit Jugal Kishore Shukla** from **Kanpur** published Udant Martand in **Kolkata**.

 
 
• 
 
The name **Udant Martand** means "**The Rising Sun**."

 
 
• 
 
It was published every **Tuesday** and aimed to deliver news to the **Hindi-speaking population**.

questions.question: What was the theme of World Wetlands Day 2025 celebrated at Parvati Arga Ramsar Site in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh?

options.text: Protecting Wetlands for our Common Future
Sustainable Wetlands for a Better Tomorrow

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Protecting Wetlands for our Common Future.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **World Wetlands Day 2025, themed ‘Protecting Wetlands for our Common Future’, was celebrated at Parvati Arga Ramsar Site, Gonda, Uttar Pradesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme emphasizes the need to value, protect, and conserve wetlands for the common future.
 
• Events highlighted the critical role of wetlands in conservation, biodiversity, and sustainable livelihoods.
 
• The event was inaugurated by UP CM Yogi Adityanath and MoS (MoEFCC) Kirti Vardhan Singh.
 
• A new nature-culture tourism corridor between Ayodhya and Devi Patan was announced.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Wetlands Day**__:

 __
 
• Celebrated on February 2nd annually to commemorate the Ramsar Convention of 1971.
 
• Aims to raise awareness about the importance of wetlands in maintaining ecological balance.
 
 
 
• **Ramsar Sites in India**__:
 __
 
• World Wetlands Day (February 2) marks the **1971 Ramsar Convention**, with India as a party since 1982.
 
• **India’s Ramsar site tally reached 98.**
 
• Recognizes wetlands of international importance, crucial for biodiversity and water resources.
 
 
 
• **Amrit Dharohar Initiative**__:
 
 
• Launched to conserve Ramsar Sites, promote tourism, and support local livelihoods.
 
• Focuses on species conservation, nature tourism, wetland livelihoods, and wetlands carbon.

questions.question: On which day is Global Tourism Resilience Day observed?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**February 17th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Global Tourism Resilience Day is observed on February 17th.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The United Nations General Assembly designated February 17th as Global Tourism Resilience Day.**
 
• The day aims to raise awareness and build capacity for resilience in the tourism sector.
 
• It highlights the vulnerabilities of the tourism industry and calls for action to address these challenges.
 
• The initiative began in 2023, and in 2024, the UN proclaimed 2027 as the International Year of Sustainable and Resilient Tourism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• UN General Assembly__

 __
 
• It plays a crucial role in declaring important days and initiatives to promote global awareness.
 
• The declaration of Global Tourism Resilience Day is part of the UN's efforts to make the tourism industry more resilient.
 
 
 
• Sustainable and Resilient Tourism__
 
 
• Refers to a tourism model that focuses on long-term sustainability while being resilient to external challenges.
 
• The International Year of Sustainable and Resilient Tourism will be celebrated in 2027.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding **Parakram Diwas 2025**:

1. Parakram Diwas 2025 marks the 125th birth anniversary of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.

2. The celebrations were hosted at Barabati Fort in Cuttack, Odisha, where Netaji was born.

3. The autobiography of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose is titled The Indian Struggle.

Which of the above statements is/are ***CORRECT***?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statement 2 is correct.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **On January 23, 2025, India celebrated Parakram Diwas to honor the 128th birth anniversary of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.**
 
• **The celebrations were hosted at Barabati Fort in Cuttack, Odisha, the birthplace of Netaji.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1 is incorrect:** Parakram Diwas 2025 marks the **128th birth anniversary of Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose**, born on January 23, 1897.
 
• **Statement 2 is correct:** The celebrations took place at **Barabati Fort in Cuttack, Odisha**, his birthplace.
 
• **Statement 3 is incorrect:** *The Indian Struggle* is not an autobiography but a historical account written by Netaji covering India’s independence movement from 1920 to 1942. Netaji did not write an autobiography.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Significance of Parakram Diwas:**__

 __
 
• Commemorates Netaji's contributions to India's independence and his indomitable spirit.
 
• Aims to inspire citizens to embody his values of courage, resilience, and patriotism.
 
 
 
• **Netaji’s Legacy:**__
 
 
• Passed ICS in 1920, resigned on Gandhiji's call; elected INC President in 1938 (Haripura) & 1939 (Tripuri), resigned due to differences with Gandhi.
 
• Founded Forward Block (1939), led Azad Hind Fauz (1943) in Singapore, & set up the Indian Provisional Government.
 
• Coined "Jai Hind" & "Dilli Chalo," wrote The Indian Struggle, & addressed Gandhi as the "Father of Nation."
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://hindi.cdn.zeenews.com/hindi/sites/default/files/2025/01/23/3618862-parakram-diwas-2025.png?im=Resize=(1200,900)]

questions.question: In which state is the India International Science festival (IISF) 2023 being organized?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The India International Science Festival (IISF) 2023 is being held in **Haryana**.
 
• IISF is an annual event organized by the Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Earth Sciences, and Vijnana Bharati (VIBHA).
 
• The festival aims to celebrate the achievements of Indian science and foster a spirit of scientific inquiry among the youth.
 
• The event features various programs and activities including science exhibitions, workshops, lectures, and interactive sessions with renowned scientists.
 
• IISF 2023 continues the tradition of bringing together students, researchers, and innovators from across the country and the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Science and Technology:**

 
 
• The Ministry of Science and Technology is a governmental body in India responsible for the formulation of policies and administration of rules and regulations related to science and technology.
 
• It comprises three departments: the Department of Science and Technology (DST), the Department of Biotechnology (DBT), and the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR).
 
• The ministry aims to promote new areas of science and technology, with special emphasis on emerging fields.
 
 
 
• **Vijnana Bharati (VIBHA):**
 
 
• Vijnana Bharati is a non-profit organization that aims to promote science and technology among the masses.
 
• It works to bridge the gap between traditional Indian knowledge systems and modern scientific research.
 
• VIBHA organizes various programs and activities to foster scientific temper and innovation.
 
 
 
• **Science Exhibitions:**
 
 
• Science exhibitions are platforms for students and researchers to showcase their scientific projects and innovations.
 
• They provide an opportunity for participants to present their work to a larger audience, including experts and peers.
 
• These exhibitions play a crucial role in encouraging scientific curiosity and hands-on learning.
 
 
 
• **Interactive Sessions with Scientists:**
 
 
• Interactive sessions with scientists provide a unique opportunity for students and young researchers to engage with experts in various fields of science.
 
• These sessions help in gaining insights into the latest scientific research and developments.
 
• They also inspire the younger generation to pursue careers in science and technology.

questions.question: International Labour Day being celebrated globally. Where was the first Labour Day in India observed?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Chennai__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] __In News__**

__
 
• International Labour Day being celebrated globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
International Labour Day is celebrated globally on **1st May**.

 
 
• 
 
It honours the **contributions and rights of the working class**.

 
 
• 
 
The day is also known as **Global Workers Day** or **May Day**.

 
 
• 
 
It originated in the **19th-century union movement in the United States**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Marxist International Socialist Congress** adopted a resolution for an **8-hour workday**.

 
 
• 
 
The day symbolizes the **struggles and achievements of workers** for economic and social rights.

 
 
• 
 
In **India**, the first Labour Day was celebrated in **1923**.

 
 
• 
 
It was organized in **Chennai** by the **Labour Kisan Party of Hindustan**.
